verdict.rationale: Cekura documents rule-based conditional actions in evaluators that respond to specific conversation conditions. Incoming calls posted via webhook automatically schedule metric evaluation, and test runs can be triggered by scheduled cron jobs or by GitHub Actions on each change. However, there is no evidence of a general user-defined event→action rule engine; the conditional actions are scoped to simulated test conversations, and the CI trigger depends on an external tool. Missing for 10: user-configurable event-triggered rules beyond evaluator conversations (e.g., alerts or outbound webhooks on metric failures or drift), documentation of the available trigger and action types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
